jobs.occupation: Associate Partner with a focus on operations and supply chain transformation, Copenhagen or Aarhus
jobs.description:
Key words and Experience:

• Copenhagen or Aarhus

• Commercial growth

• Operations and Supply Chain

• Client Engagement

Are you passionate about helping clients solve complex supply chain challenges and create lasting business value? Do you combine deep functional expertise with commercial acumen, strong client relationships and leadership experience? Are you also curious about how AI, data and digital capabilities can strengthen future operations? Then you could play a key role in growing our Supply Chain & Operations practice and leading high-impact transformations.

About Valcon

We are a European powerhouse in AI and data-driven business transformation, bringing this to life by integrating management consulting with data and digital technology capabilities.

We ensure companies are in their best possible shape and fit for the future. We spot opportunities and help bring them to life. We are thorough, fast and collaborative in everything we do. From the boardroom to the shop floor. From strategy to operations.

We are a no-nonsense consultancy with curious individuals who are driven by creating value together with clients. We have an informal culture and a flat hierarchy with offices in Denmark, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK, Germany, Croatia and Serbia.

To thrive in this role, you have demonstrated experience in these three competence areas:

• Commercial growth: Build strong client relationships, identify opportunities and contribute to the growth of existing and new client engagements through trusted advisory and business development activities

• Client engagement: Lead complex supply chain and operational improvement transformations from problem definition and solution design through implementation and value realization.

• Capability development: Help strengthen Supply Chain & Operations offerings, methodologies and market presence while leveraging AI, data and technology as key enablers of transformation

In addition, you should embody these skills:

• Supply Chain & Operations expertise: Deep experience within one or more areas such as Supply Chain Planning, S&OP, Logistics/Distribution, Procurement, Operational Excellence and Supply Chain Transformation

• People leadership: Build strong relationships, inspire teams and create an environment where people feel empowered, supported and motivated to perform

• Commercial and consulting acumen: Combine strategic thinking with a pragmatic delivery mindset and a strong understanding of how to create value for clients and grow trusted partnerships

• Digital mindset: Experience working with data, digital solutions and technology, or a strong curiosity about how these can enable better supply chain performance and business transformation

• Education: Relevant Master’s degree, fluent in English both written and spoken, Danish is a plus

Career opportunities

Valcon is in a significant growth phase supported by acquisitions and capital investment from Rivean Capital and Waterland Private Equity. This supports our ambitious expansion plans – both geographically and in terms of capabilities – with a particular focus on the Nordics and the DACH (German-speaking) region. Therefore, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape the company’s development and gain strategic influence over its future direction.

The role provides internal career development opportunities toward broader leadership roles within the capability or across the broader organisation. With Valcon’s international footprint and focus on complex Supply Chain and Operation projects in the business and technology space, you will gain access to:

• A broad network of colleagues and clients across Europe

• Strategically significant and high-complexity projects

• Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technology, including AI, data and digital technologies

Application

If this role sounds like a good match, we warmly encourage you to apply and share how your experience, strengths and perspective could contribute to the team. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

**Your impact begins here

**As Integration Project Manager, you will coordinate that data from acquisitions reaches the people who need it, when they need it. You will quickly understand the deliverables, form a plan and align stakeholders behind shared priorities and goals. Your work keeps projects moving and builds a stronger approach for future integrations.

**What You’ll Bring

**You combine structured delivery with strong stakeholder management and a practical understanding of data integration. You bring:

• Substantial experience leading complex projects across functions and organisational boundaries.

• A track record of aligning senior stakeholders, clarifying accountability and driving delivery without direct authority.

• Experience translating business needs into coordinated plans and managing dependencies, risks and competing priorities.

• An understanding of data migration or integration, including how business processes, data and IT systems relate to each other.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to make complex topics clear and actionable.

• The ability to take ownership, build trust, create momentum and work through ambiguity, challenging assumptions constructively.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**Experience with M&A integration, pharmaceutical R&D, CMC or Quality.

**What You’ll Do

**

• You will take ownership of the planning, coordination and governance of data integration, and help teams move forward when information is incomplete or circumstances change.

• Establish and drive cross-functional data integration plans with clear scope, milestones, ownership and governance.

• Align business and technical stakeholders on data requirements, priorities and delivery expectations.

• Coordinate dependencies across R&D, CMC, Quality, IT and Business Development.

• Identify and manage risks, issues and resource constraints, and escalate decisions when needed.

• Give senior stakeholders clear updates on progress, risks and decisions.

• Develop and improve ways of working for data integration, applying lessons learned across projects.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Integration Data Management in Operations and IT Quality, and work closely with colleagues across the business. In Enterprise IT & Quality, colleagues work across the Novo value chain, staying close to stakeholders and helping deliver trusted technology, high quality and responsible ways of working.

Your closest partners will be colleagues in R&D, CMC, GMS Quality, Enterprise IT and Business Development.. You will manage competing priorities across multiple projects, so success depends on autonomy, sound judgement and the ability to influence without direct authority. Clear priorities, honest conversations and quick decisions will help you move each integration forward.

**What You Can Expect Here

**Our acquisition portfolio creates a varied environment. You will shape how Novo plans and delivers data integration and strengthen our approach for future acquisitions. You will build new skills through collaboration across the value chain, and you will be trusted to take ownership, make your voice heard and perform at your best.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000 to 956,900 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring clarity to complex acquisition data integrations, apply for the Integration Project Manager role by 16 November 2026.

For further information, please contact Linda Pedersen at lsjq@novonordisk.com

jobs.description:
If you're energised by shaping the future of instrumentation and automation technologies and thrive in a pharmaceutical engineering environment, we'd love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for an Electrical & Instrumentation Engineer to join our Electrical & Instrumentation Department, consisting of approximately 100 engineers and specialists.

You will become part of a team of 100 engineers working across projects to design and deliver robust process control and instrumentation solutions for pharmaceutical facilities. Together, we cover everything from engineering design and specifications to testing, validation, and commissioning.

In this role, you will work closely with colleagues, vendors, and clients to ensure that electrical and instrumentation solutions meet both technical requirements and regulatory standards.

Please note that Danish language skills are required for this position.

Location Denmark - Kalundborg

Experience + 3 years

Department Electrical & Instrumentation

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As an E&I Engineer you’ll be:

• Design and develop instrumented designs for our current & up-coming projects

• Working with vendor and client representatives in carrying out the validation activities

• Design, development, acquisition and implementation of various sensors, actuators and control solutions to meet i.e. Functional Safety, SIS and ATEX requirements

• Commissioning, testing, qualification and validation of electrical instruments solutions

• Supervising and construction coordination

• Participating in project teams, contributing to technical problem-solving and continuous improvement

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Curious and eager to learn new skills

• Comfortable in developing close relations with stakeholders

• Taking responsibility for your tasks and approaching them proactively

• Motivated to keep deadlines and quality requirements

• Supportive and contribute to the good collaboration atmosphere

• Fostering cross organisational learning and knowledge sharing

**What You Bring To The Role

**In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Degree in Electrical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Automation or a similar field

• + 3 years of experience within electrical, instrumentation or automation engineering

• + 2 years of hands-on experience with onsite work

• Understanding of process control systems and industrial instrumentation

• Experienced in working with industrial standards and requirements, sensors and instrumentation and PI&D’s

• Commissioning, testing or validation of technical systems

• Professional level in both English and Danish

**Why choose NNE?

**NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

****Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

****Deadline of application is 15th December 2026

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Søren Hedegaard on +45 3079 8206

**Please note:

**

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Senior Business Consultant, Change Management

****Join NNIT as a Senior Business Consultant in Change Management

**Transformations succeed when people are ready, equipped and motivated to adopt new ways of working. As a Senior Business Consultant in NNIT’s working group for Change & Communication Consulting, you will help clients turn transformation ambitions into sustainable business outcomes.

Change & Communication Consulting is situated within the Life Science Project Consulting (LSPC) department. We deliver standalone and complementary services to project management, supporting clients across the people side of technology, process and organizational transformation.

You’ll join a professional, collaborative department that values quality and customer focus, while also making time for team socials, and casual get-togethers.

Location: This role will be based in Copenhagen, Denmark and will require onsite/office-based presence at customer sites as well as NNIT.

****The Role:

****As a Senior Business Consultant, you will lead change management workstreams in complex transformation programs. You will advise senior stakeholders, shape change strategies, and ensure that affected employees are prepared to adopt and sustain new processes, technologies, and ways of working.

You connect change plans to business benefit realization - ensuring adoption translates into measurable business outcomes, not just completed activities.

You will work closely with project managers, client teams, and colleagues across NNIT. Depending on the engagement, you may lead the change management track, provide strategic advisory support or contribute your expertise to a broader program.

Depending on the experience you bring, the successful candidate will be offered a position as Advanced, Senior, Principal or Managing Consultant.

****Your Responsibilities:

• Develop, implement and lead change strategies, plans, and activities in complex transformation programs.

• Assess organizational readiness, stakeholder needs and project health

• Build and coach sponsor coalitions to ensure visible, active leadership of the change

• Plan and coordinate communication, training and engagement activities

• Define and track adoption and readiness metrics

• Identify risks, resistance and adoption barriers, and develop practical responses

• Facilitate workshops with teams, functions and stakeholders across cultures.

• Translate transformation objectives into clear messages and actionable change activities

• Support the development of proposals, Request for Proposals, Statements of Work, client presentations, use cases, and thought leadership.

• Mentor and support consulting talent of tomorrow in junior-senior setups

• Contribute to the continued development of change and communication methods, tools and services.

Our approach is anchored in the Prosci® framework, while remaining adaptable to each client’s context, objectives, and needs.

****Your Qualifications:

****We are looking for an experienced profile who combines strong change management expertise with sound business understanding and the ability to work confidently with senior stakeholders.

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in delivering complex change management projects within the Life Science sector. You may have worked as a Change Manager, Transformation Consultant, Senior Consultant, Project Manager, or in a similar role.

**We Expect That You Will Have:

**

• Several years of experience with change management methods, tools, and processes

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• The ability to translate complex changes into clear actions and messages

• Experience with communication planning, training, and adoption activities

• Experience integrating change plans with a project's delivery methodology (agile, hybrid or waterfall) so change activities land at the right time

• Experience with advisory, presales, proposals, or commercial support

• Strong facilitation skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders

• Confidence working independently while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams

• Excellent English skills, both written and spoken

**It Is a Distinct Advantage If You:

**

• Have experience working in or for regulated industries such as life science or finance.

• Understand digital transformation in Regulatory, Safety, Clinical, or related life science areas.

• Are a Prosci® Certified Change Practitioner.

• Have experience from consultancy or customer-facing roles

• Are curious about human behavior, learning, culture and group dynamics.

• Are a well-liked colleague.

****Your Personal Profile:

****You are motivated by helping people and organizations succeed with change. You create clarity, build trust, and help stakeholders understand what is changing, why it matters, and how to move forward.

You are proactive, structured, and able to balance strategic direction with practical execution. You communicate clearly, collaborate naturally, and take responsibility for delivering results together with your team and customers.

****Why Join NNIT:

****At NNIT, you will join a company with strong roots in IT services, digital transformation, and regulated industries. We help customers develop, implement, and manage business critical solutions with high demands for quality, security, and reliability.

**We Offer:

**

• A professional and collaborative working environment

• Opportunities to work on meaningful projects for leading customers

• Skilled colleagues with strong business and technology expertise

• Room to grow your career and develop your consulting and change management capabilities

• A culture built on responsibility, respect, and delivering quality

****About NNIT:

****NNIT is a leading provider of IT services and consulting. We deliver solutions that support digital transformation and business critical processes for customers in Denmark and internationally. Our work is guided by a strong commitment to quality, trust, and long-term customer relationships.

**Apply now

**If you are ready to help organizations succeed with change, we look forward to hearing from you.

Please submit your CV and application through our recruitment system. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

****About NNIT

****NNIT is a publicly listed company that specializes in IT solutions to life sciences internationally, and to the public and enterprise sectors in Denmark. We focus on high complexity industries and thrive in environments where regulatory demands and complexity are high. We advise on and build sustainable digital solutions that work for the patients, citizens, employees, end users or customers.

NNIT consists of group company NNIT A/S and subsidiaries SCALES, Excellis Health Solutions and SL Controls. Together, these companies employ more than 1,600 people in Europe, Asia, and USA.

We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We actively work to eliminate bias and ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone has the right to be seen and heard as they are.
